
##### SHEET 'README' dims=B2:D57
B2='FUEL PRICE PROJECTIONS — LAC LTS/NDC OSeMOSYS PIPELINE (v2: full audit traceability)'
B3='Countries: HND, CRI, JAM, DOM, ECU, GTM | Generated: May 2026'
B5='AUDIT TRAIL — HOW TO VERIFY ANY VALUE'
B6='Every projected price is a visible Excel formula. To audit any number, click the cell. The formula references:'
B7=' • Country_XXX cell → Anchors_Countries (the May 2026 anchor with source ID, published value, FX rate, conversion note)'
B8=' • Country_XXX cell → Scenarios sheet (Brent path for that year/scenario)'
B9=' • Country_XXX cell → Anchors_Parameters (pass-through α, fuel factor)'
B10=' • Each anchor row in Anchors_Countries/Anchors_International has a Source ID (S001-S035) → Sources sheet → URL + access date'
B11=' • OSeMOSYS_VarCost cells → Country_XXX cell ÷ Anchors_Parameters energy content × 1,000,000'
B13='CONTEXT'
B14='The 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis (US-Israel war on Iran beginning 28-Feb-2026) caused the largest oil-market supply disruption on record (IEA). Brent peaked at $126/bbl in March 2026 and is trading $100-115/bbl in early May 2026. EIA STEO April 2026 raised the 2026 Brent average forecast to $96/bbl (vs $69 average in 2025) and 2027 to $76/bbl. World Bank Commodity Markets Outlook (April 2026) baseline = $86/bbl 2026, high scenario = $115/bbl.'
B15="IEA's World Energy Outlook 2025 (released November 2025, pre-Hormuz) restored the Current Policies Scenario and dropped APS. Long-term (2035-2050) Brent paths: CPS $87→$104, STEPS $80→$76, NZE $33→$25."
B17='SCENARIOS'
B18='REF  — Stated Policies (IEA STEPS) anchored. Near-term (2026-2028) = EIA STEO April 2026 Hormuz-adjusted. Long-term Brent $80/bbl 2035 → $76/bbl 2050. Default for NDCNEW and BAU.'
B19='HIGH — Current Policies (IEA CPS) + extended Hormuz / World Bank high case. Brent $115/bbl 2026 → $104/bbl 2050. Stress test for fossil-dependent technologies.'
B20='LOW  — Net Zero Emissions (IEA NZE). Demand destruction pulls prices sharply lower post-2028. Brent $55/bbl 2030 → $25/bbl 2050. Use for LTSNEW downside testing.'
B22='METHODOLOGY'
B23='1. International benchmark anchors (Brent/HH/Coal) typed into Anchors_International with per-row Source IDs. Scenarios sheet uses linear-interpolation Excel formulas between anchor years.'
B24='2. Country May-2026 anchor prices typed into Anchors_Countries with: original published value, original unit (LCU/gal or LCU/L), FX rate, pricing date, source ID, and conversion-to-USD/L note.'
B25='3. Projection formula in each Country_XXX cell: P(y,scen) = MAX( Anchor × [ 1 + α_country × factor_fuel × ( Brent(y,scen)/Brent_REF_2026 − 1 ) ], 0.30 × Anchor )'
B26='4. Floor at 30% of anchor prevents pathological negative prices in LOW scenario when Brent falls to $25/bbl.'
B27='5. OSeMOSYS VariableCost in USD/PJ = Country_XXX price (USD/L) ÷ energy content (GJ/L from IPCC defaults, S026) × 1,000,000.'
B29='DISCLOSURE — SUBSIDY FLAGS'
B30='Orange-shaded rows in Anchors_Countries indicate prices that are currently government-subsidized below import-parity. Auditors should evaluate whether your scenarios assume continued subsidies (default behavior of this model) or phase-out. If phase-out is assumed, dial pass-through α up to ~0.85-0.90 in Anchors_Parameters to approximate true import-parity for years where subsidies end.'
B31='Heavily subsidized today: ECU LPG (massive), ECU diesel power-gen, DR GLP (100% absorbed), DR Gasoil Regular (RD$88/gal subsidy), GT diesel (Q8/gal), GT gasoline (Q5/gal), JAM all transport fuels (capped JMD$4.50/L/wk).'
B33='FUEL OIL & LPG ESTIMATION NOTE'
B34="Fuel-oil and LPG anchor values for HND, CRI, ECU, GTM are derived from regional refinery economics at Brent $96/bbl (May 2026), not from country-published prices — those four don't publish refinery-gate or industrial fuel-oil prices consistently. These estimates are marked accordingly in Anchors_Countries Source/notes column. JAM and DR have published refinery-gate fuel-oil and LPG values (Petrojam, MICM). Replace estimates with country sources when available."
B36='HOW TO USE IN OSeMOSYS'
B37='VariableCost is supplied per Technology per Mode per Year per Region. Use the OSeMOSYS_VarCost sheet which already converts to USD/PJ.'
B38='For Ecuador: SpecifiedAnnualDemand is used for transport (per pipeline convention), so transport-sector fuel prices feed cost calculations indirectly. The fuel-price tables still apply for power-sector diesel/fuel-oil generation.'
B39='For Costa Rica BAU (Stage 5 specific): Use REF prices; CR is treated as ~100% renewable so fuel-cost sensitivity is marginal.'
B40='Hydro is frozen at 2026 absolute PJ values (per pipeline convention) — fuel prices for hydro are zero.'
B42='COLOR CODING'
B43='Blue text  — hardcoded input (anchor value); typically appears in Anchors_* sheets'
B44='Black text — Excel formula computed in this workbook'
B45='Green text — formula linking across sheets'
B46='Yellow fill — key year (2024, 2025, 2026, 2027, 2030, 2035, 2040, 2050)'
B47='Orange fill — value reflects government subsidy below import parity'
B49='SHEET MAP'
B50='Sources — master URL list (S001-S035), all anchors reference these IDs'
B51='Anchors_International — Brent, HH, Coal anchor years with per-row source attribution'
B52='Anchors_Countries — May 2026 country/fuel anchors with original-units trail and FX'
B53='Anchors_Parameters — Pass-through α, fuel factors, energy contents'
B54='Scenarios — 2018-2050 benchmark series (formulas from Anchors_International)'
B55='Current_Snapshot — May 2026 anchor pull-through for quick view'
B56='Country_HND/CRI/JAM/DOM/ECU/GTM — Projected USD/L by fuel/year/scenario (formulas)'
B57='OSeMOSYS_VarCost — VariableCost USD/PJ (formulas from country sheets ÷ energy content)'
